# HabitForge

> HabitForge is a habit-tracking workspace with visual streaks, integrated wellness trackers (water, weight, sleep, calories, workout, reading, expenses, mood), focus timers (Pomodoro, focus, meditation, breathing), journals (daily, gratitude, affirmations), goal setting, and a wellness dashboard. It runs on the web, on iOS and Android (via Capacitor), and as a browser extension.

This file follows the [llmstxt.org](https://llmstxt.org) format and gives AI agents an at-a-glance overview of the documentation.

## What HabitForge does

- Habit tracking with a forgiving streak engine and a visual habit-strength meter
- Integrated trackers for water, weight, sleep, calories, workouts, reading, expenses, and mood
- Focus timers: Pomodoro, focus sessions, meditation, breathing exercises
- Journals: daily journal, gratitude journal, daily affirmations, goal setting
- A unified wellness dashboard and a habit-calendar heatmap
- Web app, native iOS / Android via Capacitor, and a Chromium browser extension
- Optional Google Drive backup for journal entries (writes to the user's own Drive folder)

## What it doesn't do

- It does not have a public REST or GraphQL API. There are no programmatic integrations.
- It does not load third-party analytics or ad scripts in the browser extension.
- It does not provide health-care advice. Trackers are for personal awareness, not diagnosis.
